title: HVAC Vendor Dispatch Call — WO-2026-0438

transcript.speaker: ABC Mechanical Dispatch
transcript.text: This is ABC Mechanical dispatch. We have a technician en route to NCIA for the quarterly HVAC preventive maintenance on the Concourse A air handlers. He should arrive around 11:00 AM. Work order number is WO-2026-0438. Can you confirm the escort protocol?

transcript.speaker: Airport Operations (Duty Manager)
transcript.text: Yes, we have the work order on file. Escort will be assigned from Facilities Maintenance. We’ll confirm the escort’s name and arrival time with you via intercom when he’s on-site.

transcript.speaker: ABC Mechanical Dispatch
transcript.text: Copy that. We’ll expect the escort to contact us upon arrival. Thank you for confirming.

instructorNote: This is a legitimate vendor call. The player must verify the WO number and confirm escort coordination. Watch for over-reliance on name familiarity or failure to verify the work order.
